label: Famous quotations and catchphrases
explanation: Fires on tokens inside well-known quoted material — movie lines ("your huckleberry", "It's the only way to be sure", "Shall we play a game?"), song lyrics ("I read the news today, oh boy", "whistle while you work"), and memes/catchphrases ("I for one welcome our new overlords", "the rest of the story"). Strength peaks on the most recognizable words of verbatim quotes and drops for partial allusions, titles, and common idioms. It stays silent on ordinary prose: the fired-on tokens are common function words with ~0% individual trigger rates, so membership in a famous phrase, not token identity, drives firing.
